text: わたしの　ポケモン　こんなに　しちゃって！

structure.jp: わたしの　ポケモン
こんなに　しちゃって！
structure.en: you went and made them like this!

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: てしまう after a verb says the thing happened completely, often to the speaker's regret; ちゃう is its shortened spoken form. しちゃって = 'went and did'.

patterns.name: 〜て (trailing off)
patterns.explanation: Stopping the sentence on a て-form leaves the rest unsaid, here as a complaint. こんなに　しちゃって！ = 'doing this to them...!'.
